'''Jesba-Be Issa''' was an [[Aki-Aki]] resident of the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]] who acted as a tribal guardian of communally raised [[Youngling|children]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> By [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> Issa was an adult and attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] in the [[Forbidden Valley]]. When a group of [[Resistance]] agents arrived at the festival [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|searching]] for a [[Sith wayfinder]], they passed directly by Issa as the guardian danced among a large group of other Aki-Aki.<ref name="TROS" />

The tribal guardian then stopped dancing and stood with fellow guardian [[Fadda-Rarb Arda]] by some of the festival's [[tent]]s while holding an Aki-Aki infant. As Issa held up the infant and rocked it in the air, the Resistance agents passed by once again.<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> Issa wore a [[Color|turquoise]] flowing [[Clothing|kaftan]] that allowed for unimpeded dancing with a [[monocot-fiber]] hood suitable for a warm [[Star|sun]]. The Aki-Aki also wore a rattling purple [[pallie-pit necklace]] and a second blue [[necklace]] with [[gold]]en beads. Issa had gray skin and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jesba-Be Issa was created for the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
